cfml.globalDefinitions.source.description: The source of the global definitions.

cfml.cfDocs.source.markdownDescription:
The source for documentation.
- [CFDocs](https://cfdocs.org/): Community maintained documentation for multiple engines. Can be filtered using `#cfml.engine.name#`.
- [Lucee](https://docs.lucee.org/): Official documentation.
- Use `local` to load docs from `#cfml.cfDocs.localPath#`.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Download the latest CFDocs from GitHub each time the extension is started.

cfml.cfDocs.localPath.markdownDescription:
Path to a directory or zip file of CFDocs. Used when `#cfml.cfDocs.source#` is set to `local`.
- A directory must contain `functions.json`
- Zips must contain `functions.json` (in any subfolder, or nested zip)
- Remote URLs are supported (VS Code for the Web needs CORS headers)

cfml.hover.enable.description: Whether hover is enabled for CFML entities.

cfml.hover.html.enable.description: Whether hover is enabled for HTML entities.

cfml.hover.css.enable.description: Whether hover is enabled for CSS entities.

cfml.suggest.snippets.enable.description: Whether snippets are part of completion help.

cfml.suggest.snippets.exclude.description: Set of snippet keys you would like excluded from suggestions.

items.description: A snippet key to exclude from suggestions

cfml.suggest.scopes.case.description: What case should be used for the scopes in completion suggestions.

cfml.suggest.globalFunctions.enable.description: Whether global functions are part of completion help.

cfml.suggest.globalFunctions.firstLetter.description: What case should be used for the first letter of global function suggestions.
enumDescriptions: Leaves the name unchanged from source

cfml.suggest.globalTags.attributes.quote.description: Which quote type to use when completing attribute suggestion.

cfml.suggest.globalTags.attributes.defau.description: Whether to populate the default value for an attribute if it has one.

cfml.suggest.globalTags.includeAttribute.description: What set of attributes to include when global tag suggestion is selected
enumDescriptions: Adds no attributes on completion of global tags
Adds required attributes on completion of global tags

Adds two double quotes for attribute value
Adds two single quotes for attribute value

cfml.suggest.replaceComments.description: Whether comments are replaced during parsing (**Disabing this is Experimental**)

cfml.definition.lookbehind.maxLength.description: Maximum length of the document to look behind from the end of the word to match functions / variables / tags (-1 is the default and will backtrack to the start of the document). (**Experimental**)

cfml.definition.lookahead.maxLength.description: Maximum length of the document to look ahead from the end of the word to match functions / variables / tags(-1 is the default and will search to the end of the document). (**Experimental**)

cfml.definition.userFunctions.search.ena.description: Whether to search for matching functions throughout the workspace when a reliable match cannot be determined.

cfml.indexComponents.enable.description: Whether to index the components in workspace. This is done on each startup and is required for most features to work properly.

cfml.autoCloseTags.enable.markdownDescription: Whether to enable auto-closing tags for CFML.

cfml.docBlock.gap.description: Whether there should be a gap between the hint and other tags in a docblock

default.description: The default value for the tag

types.description: The types of structures to which this tag will be applied

items.description: A type of structure to which this tag will be applied

cfml.docBlock.extra.description: Extra tags you wish to include in every DocBlock

cfml.engine.name.description: Name of the CFML engine against which to filter.

cfml.engine.version.description: Version of the CFML engine against which to filter. SemVer format is preferred.

logicalPath.description: The logical path to which the directory path is mapped. Must start with a /.

directoryPath.description: The path to the actual directory that will be mapped. Can be a physical path or relative to the workspace root.

isPhysicalDirectoryPath.description: Whether directoryPath refers to a physical path or one relative to the workspace root

webrootPath.description: webroot path relative to mapping ( currently only used for goto route(s) )

controllerPath.description: controller path relative to mapping ( currently only used for goto route(s) )

cfml.mappings.markdownDescription:
Represents CFML mappings from logicalPath to directoryPath.

If paths are relative to a subfolder instead of the workspace root, see `#cfml.webroot#`.

cfml.webroot.markdownDescription:
A subfolder used as the web root by the ColdFusion/Lucee server.

Typically this will be blank, or a subfolder like `public`, `www`, `src`, or wherever the main `Application.cfc` is located.

Use in conjunction with `#cfml.mappings#` to resolve component paths.

cfml.comments.uncommentAnywhere.enabled.markdownDescription: A setting to enable uncomment from anywhere within a comment block.

cfml.format.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the LSP formatter. When off, formatting requests are ignored. A project's `.cfmleditor.json` overrides this.

cfml.format.selfCloseTags.markdownDescription:
Convert void/implicit-end HTML tags to self-closing form (e.g. `
` → `
`).

cfml.format.whitespaceOnly.markdownDescription: Reject formatting results that change non-whitespace content. This is the formatter's safety guard — turning it off lets a formatting defect rewrite your code.

cfml.format.queryFormat.markdownDescription: Format `<cfquery>` content (SQL re-indentation, keyword casing). When off, query content is emitted verbatim.

cfml.format.lowercaseTags.markdownDescription: Lowercase CF tag names (e.g. `<CFOUTPUT>` → `<cfoutput>`). When off, each tag keeps the casing it was written with, opening and closing halves independently.

cfml.format.doubleQuoteAttributes.markdownDescription: Normalize attribute values to double quotes.

cfml.format.blankLinesInBlocks.markdownDescription: Pad a block's body with a blank line after the opening brace and before the closing one. Off gives compact blocks, and collapses an empty body from three lines to two.

cfml.format.switchCaseIndent.markdownDescription: Indent `case` and `default` labels one level inside the switch, with their statements one further in. Off keeps the label at the `switch` keyword's own column.

cfml.format.parenSpacing.markdownDescription: Padding inside parentheses. `pad` gives `if ( a )` and `foo( 1, 2 )`; `tight` gives `if (a)` and `foo(1, 2)`. Empty keeps the existing behaviour, which pads conditions and grouping but not argument lists.

cfml.format.braceStyle.markdownDescription: Where a block's opening brace goes. `same-line` (K&R) keeps `function f() {`; `next-line` (Allman) puts the brace alone on the line below, and moves `else`, `catch` and `finally` onto their own lines so their braces line up too.

cfml.format.commaPosition.markdownDescription: Comma placement in multi-line argument lists: `after` (trailing) or `before` (leading).

cfml.format.queryCommaPosition.markdownDescription: Comma placement in SQL SELECT lists: `preserve` (keep original position), `after` (trailing) or `before` (leading).

cfml.format.lineWidth.markdownDescription: Soft column limit — attributes expand to separate lines when a tag exceeds this width.

cfml.format.paramBreakThreshold.markdownDescription: Number of parameters above which a function declaration's parameter list is expanded onto separate lines. `0` expands every list that has parameters; raise it to keep short signatures on one line.

cfml.format.attrBreakThreshold.markdownDescription: Number of attributes above which they are always expanded onto separate lines.

cfml.format.indentWidth.markdownDescription: Spaces per indentation level. A workspace `.cfmleditor.json` value outranks the editor's `tabSize`.

cfml.format.debug.markdownDescription: Enable formatter debug checks. The server re-formats its own output and warns when the result is not stable.

cfml.lsp.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the CFML Language Server (cfmleditor-lsp). When enabled, the binary is automatically downloaded from GitHub releases.

cfml.lsp.path.markdownDescription: Path to a local `cfmleditor-lsp` binary. When set, auto-download is skipped.

cfml.lsp.version.markdownDescription: Version of cfmleditor-lsp to download (e.g. `0.1.12`). Use `latest` for the most recent release.
